title: Phishing Email Anatomy
description: An interactive p5.js infographic of a realistic spear-phishing email. Six manipulation techniques are hotspots; a Spot-the-indicators mode scores the learner's clicks, and an Annotated mode reveals and explains every indicator.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Decompose a realistic spear-phishing message into its component manipulation techniques.
Identify the specific signals in an email that should trigger suspicion.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with email and web links

instructionalStrategies: Start in Spot mode and try to find all six indicators before switching to Annotated.
Discuss how spear phishing differs from bulk phishing at each hotspot.

assessmentQuestions.question: The display name reads 'Finance Department.' Why is the actual address the part that matters?
Why does manufactured urgency make an attack more effective?

chapter_title: "Human Security: Identity, Authentication, and Social Engineering"
